name: What is the step-by-step process of installing bathroom flooring?

mainEntity.name: What is the step-by-step process of installing bathroom flooring?

acceptedAnswer.text: Bathroom floor installation begins with clearing the room, shutting off water lines, and removing the toilet, baseboards, and any standing fixtures. The old flooring is torn out to expose and inspect the subfloor for moisture or framing issues. Once the subfloor is leveled and patched, contractors install a suitable moisture barrier or cement backer board. The new material is cut and laid, followed by grouting or sealing edges, reinstalling plumbing fixtures, and putting in new trim to secure a watertight perimeter.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves pulling fixtures, tearing out old flooring, repairing and leveling the subfloor, installing underlayment, laying the floor, and resealing plumbing fixtures.
